steps.text: Deep in the forest, in a dell where the berries grew fat and sweet, Pip the rabbit and Nutkin the squirrel were filling their basket.
Pop! went the berries. Plink! went the basket.
Pip was so happy she did a little jump. And then—
The basket went still. Pip's ears went straight up.
'What… was that?' whispered Pip. Nutkin didn't know.
And not knowing, somehow, was the worst part.
